title: Slack Tide Sportfishing

services.name: Charters & Tours
services.desc: If you’ve been fishing out of Ucluelet before, you’re probably familiar with Big Bank. The 20 mile journey out to these offshore waters is definitely worth the while. Here we can troll or anchor up for halibut and it’s not uncommon to hook into 50 salmon a day. If it’s a great day at the Bank, there’s nothing quite like that action. 8 hour trips only. Just south of Ucluelet is Barkley Sound and the Broken Group Islands. These calm fishing waters allow guests to get out of the swells and into a majestic network of islands and bays to fish for their salmon. Abundant with marine life and spectacular views, it’s a terrific alternative for those hoping to have a more ‘relaxing’ day on the water
